critical_code_review_comments: Apply.jsx is 2560 lines — consider splitting Step 4 (summary + store items + tour section) into a subcomponent for maintainability.

toggleTour re-seeds tourSchedule with travel.arrival_date on turn-on, but if the previous schedule had a date that user cleared, closing+reopening the switch replaces the empty date with arrival_date silently. This is user-friendly but worth confirming it's the intended behaviour.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Recipe to reach summary step in ~15s: fill contact-name/email/phone, fill precheck-arrival-date=10.12.2026, precheck-departure-date=17.12.2026, precheck-passport-expiry=01.06.2030, click precheck-continue-button, fill traveler-0-first-name/last-name/birth-date=01.01.1990/passport-no=U12345678/passport-expiry=01.06.2030, click wizard-next-step-button 2x, upload /tmp/img.jpg to traveler-0-passport-upload-input and traveler-0-photo-upload-input (wait ~3s each for OCR), click wizard-next-step-button. Then apply-tour-section becomes visible.
